hook: On the Alaska Senate floor in Juneau on May 16th, data center bill SB 250 passed 14 to 5.
deck_summary: Gold marks Alaska's three yeas in a 100-cup Senate tray at 57 and a 432-cup House tray at 417, beside two unturned sand-glasses, a three-bay exemption cabinet, SB 250's 14 and 5 and a steel rule with no enactment tick.
